key_difference: (D) implements clearLocalData() as an unconditional d.set(nullptr) and leaves the QThreadData::currentThreadData() guard (and the private qthread_p.h include) in the qcollator caller, so the new public API can re-create thread-local storage during shutdown. (B) moves that guard into a new QThreadStorageData::clear(), which makes clearLocalData() unconditionally shutdown-safe and lets the collator drop its workaround.
